description: Use this when a customer wants insurance coverage or a quote and you need the product Menlo can quote and where, for example builders risk for a renovation, vacant home insurance, a DIC policy alongside the California FAIR Plan, or event insurance. Returns published formIds, labels, states, website links and the application process. When the customer wants help insuring their risk, continue with start_quote. General product browsing needs no contact details. Availability does not guarantee eligibility or a carrier quote. Do not use for claims or changes to an existing policy.
name: list_products
title: Find Menlo insurance products
